verifiedBehaviors: Candidate origin is the cloned composition start, not the selection caret.
Typing/backspace, internal caret movement, candidate page changes retain the origin.
Document layout moves the origin; missing geometry retains only this composition anchor.
Partial/full commit, cancellation, focus and Buffer capture changes cannot reuse stale context anchors.
Buffer preedit origin and editing caret are measured independently.
Both real engine architectures pass in Chinese user/data/log paths, with UTF-8 enabled only in standalone engine processes.
observations: The two prior intermittent CTest failures did not recur in this full run; no time thresholds were relaxed.
Native TSF/Broker/librime tests use isolated fixtures; this is not a manual acceptance pass in every desktop application.
